roadmap.title: Training and first contracts
roadmap.description: Run Training, finish your first contracts, and buy the first items so the money and contract counters start climbing. Reach level 16 for Tier I.

roadmap.title: Identify every ghost
roadmap.description: Play ordinary contracts and identify each ghost the first time it appears, then leave alive. Pick up the Poltergeist, Banshee, Revenant and perfect-game unlocks along the way when those ghosts show up.

roadmap.title: Mid-game ladders and level 50 unlocks
roadmap.description: Reach level 50 for Custom Difficulty, create one, and keep working through objectives, daily and weekly tasks and the first weekly challenge. Doom Slayed is unlocked here because it needs a Custom Difficulty.

roadmap.title: Late-game counters and Apocalypse trophies
roadmap.description: Finish the 100-contract and $100,000 counters, the Tier III upgrades and the repeating weekly challenge. Do the Apocalypse trophies before your first prestige: a Deogen is the easiest ghost for them and only appears for a host at Prestige 0, level 30 or higher. The gold run also satisfies bronze and silver.

roadmap.title: Prestige grind
roadmap.description: Reach level 100 three times, prestiging after each, for Prestige I, II and III.

achievements.description: Reach Prestige III
achievements.summary: Reach Prestige III.

steps.text: Reach level 100 a third time and prestige again.

achievements.description: Successfully identify your first Banshee and survive
achievements.summary: Correctly identify a @enemy{Banshee} in the Journal and survive the contract, the first time you do so.

steps.text: Collect evidence until the ghost matches @enemy{Banshee}, whose evidence is @mechanic{Ultraviolet}, @mechanic{Ghost Orbs} and @mechanic{DOTS Projector}.
Circle @enemy{Banshee} in the Journal, then leave through the truck door alive.

achievements.description: Reach Prestige I
achievements.summary: Reach Prestige I.

steps.text: Reach level 100, then choose to prestige. Your level resets and a numeral shows on your ID card.

achievements.description: Reach Prestige II
achievements.summary: Reach Prestige II.

steps.text: Reach level 100 a second time and prestige again.

achievements.description: Complete 100 contracts
achievements.summary: Complete 100 contracts.

steps.text: Keep surviving contracts and earning rewards until you have 100. Perfect games are not needed.

achievements.description: Complete 50 contracts
achievements.summary: Complete 50 contracts.

steps.text: Keep surviving contracts and earning rewards until you have 50. Small maps on low difficulty are quickest.

achievements.description: Complete 10 contracts
achievements.summary: Complete 10 contracts.

steps.text: Survive each contract and earn at least some rewards, such as the ghost ID, an optional objective, photos or the bone, until you have 10.

achievements.description: Spend $1
achievements.summary: Spend $1 in the shop.

steps.text: Buy any item or upgrade in the shop.

achievements.description: Spend $10,000
achievements.summary: Spend a total of $10,000 in the shop.

steps.text: Keep buying equipment and upgrades; the total counts money spent over the whole game, not your balance.

achievements.description: Spend $50,000
achievements.summary: Spend a total of $50,000 in the shop.

steps.text: Keep buying equipment and upgrades. Upgrades count toward the total.

achievements.summary: Spend a total of $100,000 in the shop.

steps.text: Keep buying equipment and upgrades. You will usually reach this while buying the Tier III upgrades.

achievements.description: Complete Training
achievements.summary: Finish the Training session from start to end.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Training} on the main-menu board, below Single Player and Multiplayer, and finish every part, including recording the Ghost Orbs.

achievements.description: Complete 50 optional objectives
achievements.summary: Complete 50 optional objectives.

steps.text: Check the 3 optional objectives on the truck board or in the Journal each contract and finish as many as you can. All 50 count across contracts.

achievements.description: Witness a Poltergeist ability.
achievements.summary: Witness a @enemy{Poltergeist} use its throwing ability.

guide.context: No other ghost scatters a pile this way.

steps.text: When the ghost is a @enemy{Poltergeist}, pile several small items together near it.
Stay close and wait until the ghost scatters the whole pile at once.

achievements.description: Complete your first contract.
achievements.summary: Complete your first contract.

steps.text: Play any contract, identify the ghost, and leave through the truck door alive.

achievements.description: Get killed by a Banshee in multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Be killed by a @enemy{Banshee} while playing in a multiplayer game.

guide.context: The Banshee has to pick you as its target.

steps.text: Play a multiplayer contract and wait until the evidence shows a @enemy{Banshee}.
Let your sanity drop in the dark.
When the Banshee hunts, walk toward it instead of hiding.

achievements.description: Get killed by a Demon ability within the first minute.
achievements.summary: Die from a @enemy{Demon} ability during the first minute of a contract.

guide.context: Demons are able to start hunts even when your sanity is full. The ghost type is random, so expect many tries.

steps.text: Reach account level 50, then make a Custom Difficulty that causes early hunts. Leave the ghost type unchosen: picking one sets the multiplier to 0 and the contract gives no progress.
Leave the truck, start a timer, and enter the house.
Wait up to 60 seconds for the Demon to hunt. If the minute ends first, quit and try again.

achievements.description: Obtain the Bronze Apocalypse Trophy
achievements.summary: Earn the Bronze Apocalypse Trophy: clear a solo run at @loc{Sunny Meadows Mental Institution} with a Custom Difficulty multiplier of 6.00x or more.

guide.context: A 15.00x run for Gold also earns Bronze and Silver. The trophy upgrades in colour instead of adding a new one.

steps.text: Reach account level 50 so Custom Difficulty is available.
Pick the Apocalypse I preset, or build a Custom Difficulty that shows a multiplier of at least 6.00x.
Start a single-player contract on @loc{Sunny Meadows Mental Institution}.
Complete all four objectives and capture any ghost media.
Identify the ghost in the Journal, then leave through the truck door alive.

achievements.description: Obtain the Silver Apocalypse Trophy
achievements.summary: Earn the Silver Apocalypse Trophy: clear a solo run at @loc{Sunny Meadows Mental Institution} with a Custom Difficulty multiplier of 10.00x or more.

guide.context: A 15.00x run for Gold also earns Silver. The trophy upgrades in colour instead of adding a new one.

steps.text: Reach account level 50 so Custom Difficulty is available.
Pick the Apocalypse II preset, or build a Custom Difficulty that shows a multiplier of at least 10.00x.
Start a single-player contract on @loc{Sunny Meadows Mental Institution}.
Complete all four objectives and capture any ghost media.
Identify the ghost in the Journal, then leave through the truck door alive.

achievements.description: Obtain the Gold Apocalypse Trophy
achievements.summary: Earn the Gold Apocalypse Trophy: clear a solo run at @loc{Sunny Meadows Mental Institution} with a Custom Difficulty multiplier of 15.00x.

guide.context: This run covers Bronze and Silver too. The ghost hunts quickly, you start with no sanity, the ghost gives no evidence, and you cannot sprint.

steps.text: Reach account level 50 so Custom Difficulty is available.

Choose the Apocalypse III preset, which gives 15.00x. Do not change its settings: player speed of 75% gives about 14.6x, which only earns Silver, and a setup time above 0 drops the multiplier to 1.00x.
Start a single-player contract on @loc{Sunny Meadows Mental Institution}.
Redo the contract until the 3 optional objectives are easy, such as detecting EMF, smudging the ghost or stopping a hunt with a Crucifix.
Complete all four objectives and capture any ghost media.
Identify the ghost in the Journal, then leave through the truck door alive.
A Deogen is the easiest ghost for this run: it slows down when you are close, so you can circle it around the chapel pews. A Deogen needs a host at Prestige 0 and level 30 or higher.

achievements.description: Unlock all tier one equipment
achievements.summary: Unlock every tier one equipment upgrade.

steps.text: Buy every Tier I upgrade in the shop. Tier I finishes at about level 16.

achievements.description: Unlock all tier two equipment
achievements.summary: Unlock every tier two equipment upgrade.

steps.text: Buy every Tier II upgrade in the shop. Tier II finishes at about level 49.

achievements.description: Unlock all tier three equipment
achievements.summary: Unlock every tier three equipment upgrade.

steps.text: Buy every Tier III upgrade in the shop. The last ones unlock at about level 80 to 90.

achievements.description: Complete a perfect investigation.
achievements.summary: Complete a perfect investigation.

guide.context: Three-star photos alone are not enough; the Journal slots need unique media.

steps.text: Identify the ghost correctly in the Journal.
Complete all 3 optional objectives.
Collect the bone.
Fill the Journal media slots with unique evidence, not duplicates.
Leave through the truck door alive.

achievements.description: Create a custom difficulty
achievements.summary: Create a custom difficulty.

guide.context: You do not have to play the difficulty you create.

steps.text: Reach account level 50, open Custom Difficulty, change any settings, and apply it.

achievements.description: Escape a Revenant.
achievements.summary: Survive a hunt by a @enemy{Revenant}.

guide.context: A Revenant moves fast while hunting but slows down while you are hidden.

steps.text: Identify the ghost as a @enemy{Revenant}, then let it start a hunt.
Hide, or use a @item{Smudge Stick} when it gets close to blind it, then move away.
When the hunt ends, leave the building and close the truck door.

achievements.description: Complete 30 daily tasks
achievements.summary: Complete 30 daily tasks.

steps.text: Check the daily board each session and finish its tasks. A new list of 4 tasks appears every 24 hours.

achievements.description: Complete 10 weekly tasks
achievements.summary: Complete 10 weekly tasks.

steps.text: Check the weekly board and finish its tasks. A new list of 4 tasks appears every 7 days.

achievements.description: Complete a weekly challenge mode
achievements.summary: Complete a weekly challenge mode.

guide.context: The challenge changes every week, so you can retry until it rotates.

steps.text: Open the weekly task sheet and start the weekly challenge. The truck holds a fixed set of equipment.
Finish the challenge and leave through the truck door.

achievements.description: Complete the weekly challenge mode 5 times
achievements.summary: Finish the weekly challenge five separate times.

steps.text: Finish the weekly challenge in 5 different weeks.

achievements.description: Complete the weekly challenge mode 10 times
achievements.summary: Finish the weekly challenge ten separate times.

steps.text: Finish the weekly challenge in 10 different weeks.
